Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in the specified document. Join docs by chembl_id, then join compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno, then join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
